text: Free RPG demo set inside the body of a dying sea monster.
You play as Clyde the Intern.
In there, people built a village, and somehow an office building, into the monster's flesh.
Fights are turn-based, JRPG style, with party members that look like cut-out photos.
Best part: it's gloriously weird. A fisherman wants to destroy the soggy demon from within.
The catch? The animation is deliberately janky. Characters mostly just wobble.
There's even platforming, with a rope swing over pools of acid.
The demo is about two gigs, in five languages, and the full game is due in twenty twenty-seven.
Think Earthbound, if it got swallowed by a whale.
Worth a dip if you like your RPGs strange.
